node.title: Rank-eleven relative core-interpolant and correction-ray payment
node.closure: field-general root-capacity payment of the H_C core interpolant and one complete correction ray
node.statement: For every H_C residual row with 10<=K'<=1048576, empty maximal common support bounds core-interpolant slopes by 481. For any fixed nonzero correction direction, clone-class removal and a coarse heterogeneous-pair count bound all rich correction pairs by n'(n'-m'+1)+31 binom(n',2), at most 70227214729216. Core plus one ray is 70227214729697, strictly below the official KoalaBear budget. Hence an unsafe H_C family requires many projectively independent correction directions or a higher-dimensional correction span.
